title: QueueEnqueueV2Response
description:
Enqueue response carrying the immutable subject generation allocated to the
entry.

enqueued.description: `true` when this call created the entry; `false` for an idempotent replay.

subject.description: Immutable subject generation allocated to the entry.

warning.description: Optional advisory that does not weaken the generation fence.

SubjectGeneration.description: A canonical subject identity and the immutable generation being executed.

generation.description:
Positive backend/queue generation. A later generation cannot be
satisfied by work or proof from an earlier one.
